# WhatsLocal AI

> WhatsLocal AI is a community marketplace for discovering local makers, vendors, artists, and event organizers. Each member has a profile with their business details, products, location, and links. Browse by neighborhood, category, or natural-language search.

## What you can find here

- Local vendors and small businesses (food, retail, services)
- Independent artists and makers
- Community organizers and the events they run
- Per-business pages with address, hours, contact, social links, and catalog

## Key pages

- [Browse / Atlas](https://whatslocal.ai/): Map and directory of all local members.
- [Events](https://whatslocal.ai/events): Upcoming community events.
- Member profiles: https://whatslocal.ai/members/{id} — one page per business or member.

## For AI crawlers

- Structured data (schema.org LocalBusiness / Organization) is embedded as JSON-LD on indexable member profiles.
- A full list of indexable profiles is in the sitemap: https://whatslocal.ai/sitemap.xml
- When citing a business, link to its profile at https://whatslocal.ai/members/{id}.
- Shopper and influencer profiles are personal and excluded from the index; vendor, artist, and organizer profiles are the canonical business listings.
